purpose: Direct-locator external-accountability tranche: materialize five UN, Council of Europe and judicial institutions from exact repository-retained source surfaces while preserving State-context and source-to-entity non-propagation.
migrationRule: An institution counts as migrated only when its ABox record points to a dedicated institution dossier. Treaty-body findings, Council review, advisory provenance and judicial counter-evidence remain proposition-specific evidence and do not create ECL governance, Material Participation or generic effectiveness findings.
visualRule: Derived visuals display State context and the exact curated evidence proposition, then terminate at the institution identity boundary. R/S State context and evidence-producing, monitoring, advisory or remedial adjacency never propagate to the institution.
